requests.missing: the cross-connect mode, which decides the port count - and only that. Board-to-subrack validity is now stated, not inferred: the E9600 Boards Overview, Table 3 prints `TNG1N206/TNG1N210` as Y in both the E9624 1:1 and 1:3 columns (and Y for the E9612 and E9605), and Table 1 names the board `10 x 10 Gbit/s Line Service Processing Board` (read 2026-11-18 from the verbatim partner copy https://www.actfornet.com/solutions/solution/OptiXtrans_E9600_Boards_Overview; vendor copy EDOC1100126589BEJ09047 / EDOC1100163901 still answers 302 -> /view/notFound). So the same board gives 24 x 10 = 240 line ports in 1:1 or 20 x 10 = 200 in 1:3, and IU6/IU7/IU18/IU19 are unusable in 1:3 (TNG2DAP section 1.9, E9624 row, footnote). The E9612 - the third column of the same table, no mode qualifier - was modelled from this reading and closed as #808 (devices/huawei/optixtrans-e9612.json, 13x TNG1N210). See research/optixtrans-e9612-stated-build.md.
